name: Arroz
tagline: The legendary red rice. Honestly the chicken broth is doing all the work.
description:
Method

  1. Warm the chicken broth in a separate pot. Keep it hot — you'll need it.
  2. Heat a pan with oil over low heat. When warm, pour in the rice and toast, stirring occasionally.
  3. Add the garlic cloves and onion half unchopped to the rice. Stir and roast together until the rice turns light brown.
  4. Add the chopped tomatoes and enough chicken broth to just cover the rice.
  5. Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.
  6. Keep a pot of hot water nearby in case the rice dries out before it's done. Do not use cold water — it will shock the rice.

name: Banana Bread
tagline: Four ripe bananas, oil not butter, two loaves. The ratio is the whole recipe.
description:
Method

  1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
  2. Whisk flour and baking soda together. Set aside.
  3. Beat the eggs. Mix in sugar, vegetable oil, and mashed bananas.
  4. Add the flour mixture and stir until no dry spots remain.
  5. Pour into two greased bread pans.
  6. Bake 50–55 minutes. Test with a toothpick — it should come out clean if it's done.

name: Cacio e Pepe
tagline: Three ingredients. Four if you count the water.

ingredients.name: tonnarelli
ingredients.notes: spaghetti or your fav pasta works too

description:
Method

  1. Toast the pepper. Dry pan, low heat, smell it bloom.
  2. Pasta in salted water — less salt than you think. The cheese is salty.
  3. Reserve a cup of water. Drain pasta one minute under.
  4. Off the heat: pecorino, splash of water, whisk to a paste. Add pasta. Toss like you mean it.
  5. If it breaks, you added cheese too hot. Start again.

name: Carne Asada
tagline: Skirt steak, charred lime, no shortcuts. This is the güey.
description:
Method

  1. Marinade. Blitz everything except the steak. Pour over the meat. Bag it. Six hours minimum, twelve is better.
  2. Heat. The grill must scream. Smoke point or you've already failed.
  3. Sear. Two minutes per side. No moving the meat around like an amateur.
  4. Rest. Ten minutes. Under foil. Walk away.
  5. Slice. Against the grain. Thin. Salt on the cutting board.

name: Cowboy Butter
tagline: Six tablespoons of butter, Dijon, cayenne, garlic. Melt and stir — that's the recipe.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.notes: zest of 1 lemon + juice of 1/2 lemon

description:
Method

  1. Melt butter in a pan. Add Dijon, cayenne, paprika, lemon zest, and garlic. Stir to combine.
  2. Stir in chili flakes, thyme, parsley, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

name: Fish Tacos
tagline: Beer battered, cabbage, crema. A San Diego classic.

ingredients.name: cod
ingredients.notes: cut into fingers; rockfish or any white fish will also do

description:
Method

  1. Whisk the batter cold. Cold. Lumps are fine.
  2. Oil at 375°F. Test with a wooden spoon — should hiss.
  3. Dip fish, fry 3 minutes, drain on rack — never paper towels, you'll steam them soggy.
  4. Build: tortilla, fish, cabbage, crema, lime. Done.

name: French Toast
tagline: Butter bread, egg custard, maple syrup. A breakfast maple staple.
description:
Method

  1. Crack eggs into a shallow dish.
  2. Add milk and whisk in vanilla, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
  3. Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium heat.
  4. Dip bread slices in egg mixture on both sides — coated, not soaked through.
  5. Fry until golden brown, about 2–3 minutes per side.
  6. Serve warm with butter and maple syrup. Powdered sugar if you want.

name: Mashed Potatoes
tagline: Russets and Yukons, a stick and a half of butter, sour cream. That's the whole secret.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: I prefer Russets; peel and cut into thick pieces

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: about 1 1/2 sticks; have a tbsp or two extra for toppings

ingredients.name: ranch seasoning
ingredients.notes: Hidden Valley or DIY; optional but tasty

description:
Method

  1. Fill a large pot with water and ensure potatoes are submerged in it, then add a generous pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook until they are softened, most likely around 15 minutes.
  2. Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. Mash with a potato masher or ricer until desired smoothness but don't overdo it. Too much gets the texture funny. Less is more.
  3. While potatoes cook, warm milk and 3/4 cup butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until butter melts, about 3 minutes.
  4. Pour milk mixture over potatoes and stir until creamy. Add sour cream and stir to combine. Season generously with salt and pepper. If you enjoy a ranch-like mashed potatoes, add the ranch seasoning as well.
  5. Transfer to a serving bowl. Top it off with some extra butter, pepper, and parsley.

name: Mexican Hot Chocolate Cookies
tagline: Cayenne, cinnamon, molten marshmallow. Chocolate cookie with a secret inside.

ingredients.name: ground cinnamon
ingredients.notes: (2 tsp for dough, 1 tsp for coating)

description:
Method

  1. Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, salt, cayenne, instant espresso powder, and 2 tsp cinnamon in a medium bowl. Set aside.
  2. Beat butter and brown sugar on medium-high until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add egg and vanilla. Beat until creamy, 2 more minutes. Add flour mixture and beat on low until no dry spots remain, about 1 minute.
  3. Scoop dough into 2-tablespoon mounds on a baking sheet. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, up to overnight. Freeze marshmallows if you haven't already.
  4. Heat oven to 350°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment. Mix the granulated sugar and remaining 1 tsp cinnamon in a small bowl.
  5. Let dough sit 5 minutes at room temperature if very stiff. Flatten a mound in your palm, pile 5 frozen marshmallows in the center, and bring the dough up and over to fully enclose them. Roll into a ball, then roll in cinnamon sugar. Place 3 inches apart on prepared sheets.
  6. Bake 10–12 minutes, rotating halfway, until cookies puff and bits of molten marshmallow peek through. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.

Notes: Uncoated dough balls freeze for up to 3 months. To bake from frozen, thaw 5 minutes, roll in cinnamon sugar, and bake 13–15 minutes.

name: Pozole Verde de Pollo
tagline: Tomatillo-blended broth, fall-apart chicken, three cans of hominy. The green is the whole point.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.notes: bone-in is better; boneless is okay

ingredients.name: jalapeño peppers
ingredients.notes: de-seeded if you want less spicy

ingredients.name: Mexican oregano
ingredients.notes: Regular oregano works but will disappoint

description:
Method 1 — Full Spicy Batch

  1. Fill a large pot with the broth.
  2. Add in the chicken thighs, tomatillos, one rough-chopped onion, jalapeños, garlic, oregano, salt.
  3. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to low, partially cover, and simmer for about 40 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
  4. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and either shred it or chop it into pieces. Set this aside for now.
  5. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked tomatillos, onion, jalapeños, and garlic to a blender. Add 1 cup of the cooking liquid and the cilantro. Blend until completely smooth.
  6. Pour the green sauce back into the pot. Stir in the shredded chicken and drained hominy.
  7. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Cook uncovered 15 minutes. Taste and season with salt and a squeeze of lime.
  8. Ladle into bowls. Serve with sliced radishes, shredded cabbage, chopped cilantro, diced white onion, lime wedges, and a sprinkle of oregano.

Method 2 — Half Mild, Half Spicy Batch 

  1. Fill a large pot with 6 cups of broth. Fill a medium pot with the remaining broth.
  2. Add in the chicken thighs, tomatillos, one rough-chopped onion, garlic, oregano, salt. Add the jalapeños to the medium pot.
  3. Bring both pots to a boil over high heat. Reduce to low, partially cover, and simmer for about 40 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
  4. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and either shred it or chop it into pieces. Set this aside for now.
  5. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked tomatillos, onion, and garlic to a blender. Add 1 cup of the cooking liquid and the cilantro. Blend until completely smooth.
  6. Pour half of the green sauce back into the large pot. 
  7. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the jalapeños into the blender with the remaining half of the green sauce. Add 1 cup of the broth from the medium pot. Blend until completely smooth.
  8. Split the shredded chicken and drained hominy in half for each pot and stir them in.
  9. Bring both pots to a simmer over medium-high heat. Cook uncovered 15 minutes. Taste and season with salt and a squeeze of lime.
  10. Ladle into bowls. Serve with sliced radishes, shredded cabbage, chopped cilantro, diced white onion, lime wedges, and a sprinkle of oregano.

name: Puppy Chow
tagline: Chex, chocolate, peanut butter, powdered sugar. Diabetes never tasted so good.
description:
Method

  1. Measure cereal into a large bowl. Set aside.
  2. Microwave chocolate chips, peanut butter, and butter for 1 minute on high. Stir. Microwave another 30 seconds until smooth. Stir in vanilla.
  3. Pour mixture over cereal and stir until fully coated.
  4. Transfer to a large Ziploc bag. Add powdered sugar, seal, and shake until well coated.
  5. Spread on waxed paper to cool. Store in a sealed bag or container.

Note: If you only have small bags, add the cereal a little at a time when shaking with the powdered sugar.

name: The Cheddar Salmon
tagline: Poached in Chardonnay, cheddar-crusted, on a spinach bed. Treat it like a king.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: or replace entirely with white wine if you're about that life

description:
Method

  1. Grate a big bowl of sharp cheddar. Set aside.
  2. Sauté onions in butter. Add spinach and sauté until wilted.
  3. Transfer spinach to an oven-safe dish. Spread into a bed wide enough for the salmon to rest on.
  4. Poach salmon in Chardonnay and water with salt, peppercorns, and bay leaves, for about 10 minutes.
  5. Place poached salmon on the spinach bed. Cover with the grated cheddar.
  6. Cover dish with foil. Bake at 400°F for ~15 minutes or until the cheese melts.
  7. Remove foil and let cool.
